vi.sub: Ket luan cho phep phat hanh

zh.sub: 当前主结论为 ready，阻断与提示项均为空，可按标准节奏推进。

en.sub: Current top-level conclusion is ready, with no blockers or advisories, so standard release flow can proceed.

vi.sub: Ket luan tong la ready, khong co blocker hay advisory, co the tiep tuc theo quy trinh chuan.

diffSubcopy.zh: 变化层按 stable 解读：先确认本轮无新增风险，再进入动作执行。
diffSubcopy.en: Read the change layer as stable: confirm no new risk was introduced before taking action.
diffSubcopy.vi: Doc lop thay doi la stable: xac nhan khong co rui ro moi truoc khi hanh dong.

firstAction.zh: 先确认 generatedAt 为当前轮次，再执行正式放行并同步值班结论。
firstAction.en: Confirm generatedAt belongs to the current run first, then execute formal release and sync the duty conclusion.
firstAction.vi: Xac nhan generatedAt thuoc dung lan chay hien tai truoc, sau do phat hanh chinh thuc va dong bo ket luan truc.

vi.sub: Ket luan yeu cau tam dung

zh.sub: 当前主结论为 blocked 或已出现阻断原因，值班上应按风险上升处理，禁止直接发布。

en.sub: Top-level conclusion is blocked or blocking reasons are present, so operators should treat this as risk-up and stop direct release.

vi.sub: Ket luan tong la blocked hoac da co ly do chan, nen can xem day la rui ro tang va dung phat hanh truc tiep.

diffSubcopy.zh: 变化层按 risk_up 解读：先看新增阻断，再决定修复顺序。
diffSubcopy.en: Read the change layer as risk_up: review newly surfaced blockers before choosing the fix order.
diffSubcopy.vi: Doc lop thay doi la risk_up: xem cac blocker moi xuat hien truoc khi chon thu tu sua loi.

firstAction.zh: 先处理 reasons 首项，再重跑 release-command-center-latest 确认是否回落。
firstAction.en: Resolve the first item in reasons, then rerun release-command-center-latest to verify whether the risk has dropped.
firstAction.vi: Xu ly muc dau trong reasons, sau do chay lai release-command-center-latest de xac nhan rui ro da giam hay chua.

conditions: advisories.length > 0 OR generatedAt is missing OR generatedAt == ''

vi.sub: Ra soat truoc khi phat hanh

zh.sub: 当前主结论为 GO，但仍有提示项或时间证据不足，需人工复核后再决定动作。

en.sub: Top-level conclusion is GO, but advisories remain or time evidence is insufficient, so manual review is required before action.

vi.sub: Ket luan tong la GO nhung van con advisory hoac bang chung thoi gian chua du, can ra soat thu cong truoc khi hanh dong.

diffSubcopy.zh: 变化层按 review 解读：先看变化提示，再决定是否继续发布。
diffSubcopy.en: Read the change layer as review: inspect change hints first, then decide whether release should continue.
diffSubcopy.vi: Doc lop thay doi theo huong review: xem cac goi y thay doi truoc, sau do moi quyet dinh co tiep tuc phat hanh hay khong.

firstAction.zh: 先核对 advisories 与 generatedAt，再决定是否进入正式放行。
firstAction.en: Verify advisories and generatedAt first, then decide whether to enter formal release.
firstAction.vi: Kiem tra advisories va generatedAt truoc, sau do moi quyet dinh co vao buoc phat hanh chinh thuc hay khong.
